notes: Recorded 39 English-taught master's programmes and 67 doctoral rows (9 programmes from the English programmes page plus 58 English-medium research fields from the 2027 doctoral catalogue).

The official English programmes page states 9 doctoral and 31 master's programmes (31 counted from its table); the 7 September 2026 reminder says 28 master's; the 2027 admission notice says 40 master's and doctoral programmes in English. The master's catalogue filtered to English-medium rows adds MIDG, IMPA-BRI, IMPA-FL, three more LL.M. programmes (International Arbitration and Dispute Settlement, Intellectual Property and Innovation Policy, Technology Law and Policy) and IMPH-Global that are not on the English page; these are included and the difference is noted here. The Master of Global Industrial Innovation Program (part-time) is on the English page but has no English-medium row in the catalogue; it is included from the English page.

The earlier stored list had 25 master's programmes; the six English-page programmes it lacked are Biomedical Engineering and Translational Medicine, Synthetic Biology and Biomanufacturing, Intelligent Instrument and Equipment, Logistics Engineering and Management, Master of Urban Systems in Human Habitats and Future Science and Technology and Industry.

Doctoral: the English page names 9 doctoral programmes. The catalogue lists English-medium research fields under Environment, Computer Science, Journalism and Communication, Public Health, Qiuzhen College (6 fields under Mathematics) and the Shenzhen International Graduate School (44 fields under Data Science and Information Technology, 7 under Environment Science and New Energy Technology, 1 under Precision Medicine and Healthcare). Tsinghua also says most doctoral programmes in engineering and natural science are conducted in English; the catalogue does not flag them as English-medium, so they are not listed (the full Chinese and English catalogue lives on the application platform).
The catalogue pages open without a login; they were read in a browser and the English-medium filter was applied with the page's own controls.
not_stated: A complete list of the doctoral programmes in engineering and natural science that are delivered in English beyond those the catalogue flags.
Which of the Chinese-taught or bilingual programmes accept applicants without Chinese.
fetch_problems: The catalogue is a JavaScript application; its text was read in the browser. Departments on the English page without an English-medium catalogue row (Materials Science and Engineering doctoral, Global Industrial Innovation) are included from the English page only.
